messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"TADAM","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"TADAM","units":[{"text":"When they were driven out from paradise, they made themselves a booth, and spent seven days mourning and lamenting in great grief.","chapter":1,"source_ref":"1:1"},{"text":"But after seven days, they began to be hungry and started to look for victual to eat, and they","chapter":2,"source_ref":"2:1"},{"text":"found it not. Then Eve said to Adam: 'My lord, I am hungry. Go, look for (something) for us to eat. Perchance the Lord God will look back and pity us and recall us to the place in which we were before.","chapter":2,"source_ref":"2:2"},{"text":"And Adam arose and walked seven days over all that land, and found no victual such as they","chapter":3,"source_ref":"3:1"},{"text":"used to have in paradise. And Eve said to Adam: 'Wilt thou slay me that I may die, and perchance God the Lord will bring thee into paradise, for on my account hast thou been driven thence.'","chapter":3,"source_ref":"3:2"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 1:1, 2:1, 2:2, 3:1, 3:2.
